03 / Engineering approach

How I approach
the work.

Understand the constraints.
Make the change. Verify the result.

01

Follow the dependencies.

A pod failure may start in storage, networking, permissions or configuration. I investigate across layers to find the cause.

02

Make delivery repeatable.

Use Python, Bash, infrastructure as code and established pipeline components to make recurring work consistent and reviewable.

03

Close the feedback loop.

Use metrics, logs and workload health to check what changed. Review and test AI-assisted work before deployment.

04 / About & toolkit

Hi, I’m Lohith.

I’m a Platform / DevOps Engineer with an SRE background, based in Karimnagar, India. My work spans the layers that make software useful: infrastructure, delivery, storage and reliability.

From payment infrastructure at NPCI to helping build a data architecture platform for SIX Swiss Exchange through Flexilant Works, I enjoy figuring out how the pieces fit — and making them work together.

I also use Cursor, Claude and GitHub Copilot in my engineering workflow, reviewing and testing AI-assisted changes before they’re deployed.
